title: Maximum acceptance probability
statement: Let $V$ be a PCPP system with Boolean inputs of positive length, proof length $L$, and a finite query count. The optimum acceptance probability is the acceptance probability of an input-proof pair maximizing acceptance probability over all Boolean inputs and proofs of length $L$.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is a PCPP system over Boolean symbols
